title: The Pixel 11 isn’t the best Pixel of 2026, but it’s the smartest buy
summary: The Pixel 11 Pro is your answer. However, as someone who bought the Pixel 9 Pro two years ago, the Pixel 11’s blend of good-enough hardware and compelling software feels Pro enough to me.
